usageNotes: Use this endpoint once to bootstrap a new Proxmox VE cluster from a standalone node — it is a one-time, irreversible cluster initialization, not a reconfiguration of an existing cluster. The node must not already belong to a cluster; running this on a node that is already clustered will fail. Returns a task UPID (string) for an async operation; poll the task status before attempting to join additional nodes.

examples.summary: Create a two-link cluster named 'pve-cluster' with a dedicated corosync ring

tips: clustername follows the pve-node format: max 15 chars, alphanumeric and hyphens only.
If link[n] is omitted, Proxmox defaults to the node's primary IP as link0 — explicitly set it for multi-NIC or bonded corosync rings.
token-coefficient tunes the corosync token timeout for high-latency links; leave at default (125) for LAN clusters.
After this call succeeds and the UPID task completes, use post_cluster_config_nodes to join additional nodes to the cluster.
You cannot undo cluster creation via the API — to revert a node to standalone you must use pvecm destroycluster from the shell.
